blurb: Seattle Ballooning offers hot air balloon rides launching just south of Seattle, designed to showcase Mt. Rainier with views of the Cascade and Olympic Mountains, Puget Sound, and local lakes. Flights last about 60 minutes with the whole experience around 2.5 hours. They offer shared and private flights for groups from 2 to 10 passengers, with corporate and special event options.
extraNote: If flight is canceled due to weather, reschedule or refund offered · Tickets for Winthrop Balloon Roundup are non-refundable; flight credit issued for weather cancellation · Pick up at Muckleshoot Casino for Seattle flights · May through October
